ns2:section.sectionText: This course is the introduction of game theory and strategic decision making. We will cover basic concepts and topics in modern game theory, such as Nash equilibrium, dominance, voting, bargaining, auction, adverse selection, etc, which have broad applications in economics, politics, psychology, and everyday life. RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS. At this time, we do not plan on lifting the restriction.
